name: @iterahq/screens
description: Universal screens: one source rendered by the web app (react-native-web) and by the native shell (React Native), styled by the same Tailwind classes (Uniwind). Source-only: no build step. No dependency entry on purpose: react, react-native and uniwind come from the host that bundles a screen (the root install on the web, apps/mobile in the shell), so there is one React per bundle.
